design: Factor aligned input writes of layer14 head4 into signed coefficients and projected effective values. Fit mean coefficient change and mean receiver value per input-token ordinal from first4 discovery items only. Apply mean coefficient change to heldout receiver values; compare unconditional mean baseline, product of discovery means, exact-coefficient/receiver-value, receiver-coefficient/exact-value and exact-input controls. Keep all other mean predictions fixed; predicted/exact boundary.
limitations: Known task/form, frozen templates, retrospective panel. Oracle controls donor-informed; mean-coefficient prediction uses receiver factors only. Multi-token inputs matched by complete token-ID sequence, fixed count per family; no output fitting.
